title: Witness a characteristic-3 rank-36 pattern on P104.
body: ## Change and mathematical scope Scoped partial result. No new κ and no selected-frontier change. The selected record stays κ = `781451/250000000`. Characteristic 3 admits a rank-36 1-block pattern on the P104 port window. The pattern is an explicit witness, not a minimum and not a census of patterns. Two different claims: 1. **Proof, restricted ansatz.** In characteristic 3 the odd-graph adjacency matrix satisfies `A^2 = 0`. Every matrix constant on the diagonal, on edges, and on non-edges is then either illegal (zero diagonal) or invertible of rank 120. The reduction of `3I−A` is the illegal case. This does not forbid a non-constant pattern of rank 36. 2. **Witness, outside that ansatz.** The 46 monomials of degree at most 2, including the constant, give a 1-block pattern over `F_3` of rank 37 on `P120` and rank 36 on `P104`. Field extension preserves these ranks, so for every field `F` of characteristic 3, `w(P104; F) ≤ 36` and `w(P120; F) ≤ 37`. One deleted 8-clique extension (`P112`) has rank 36 and the other has rank 37. The witness is one point of a positive-dimensional family (coefficient nullities 4 and 9; legal-column dimensions 3 and 8). Free coordinates were set to 0. That family was not searched, so the rank-37 value on `P120` is not a minimum inside the ansatz and not an unrestricted lower bound. Accepting #6933, Theorem 4, without replaying it, `w(P104; F)` now lies in `[13, 36]` in characteristic 3. The upper end previously held only off characteristic 3. Equality is not claimed. This is not a word, a paid profile, or a decoder realisation for `k > 1`. ## Task and overlap Base commit: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. Card `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, priority revision 8. Scope status: **changed**. The card asks whether a decoder or coframe change improves the signed moment. The actual result answers the characteristic-3 rank-36 question left open by discussion comment 19492602 for the P104 window only. No moment is computed. Nearest work: - #6933 defines the window, proves `w ≥ 53/6` over every field and the odd-character lower bounds 13, 14 and 15, and leaves odd-character upper bounds open. Its port list is vendored byte-for-byte. - Discussion comment 19492602 and fork PR 151 prove `w ≤ 36` off characteristic 3 and `w ≤ 38` in characteristic 3, by `3I−A` and by a degree-2 pattern with no constant term. This package does not redo those upper bounds. The same no-constant solver is rechecked and gives rank 38 on `P120` and rank 37 on `P104`; the constant monomial is what drops `P104` from 37 to 36. - #6471, #6528 and #6649 use Haemers or fitting-rank language on other masks. They do not decide this characteristic-3 question. An overlap search of 885 open upstream PRs and 6934 discussion records on 2026-11-10 found no settled characteristic-3 rank-36 pattern for this window. - The `F_5` rank-13 factorisation is a different question and is not investigated. Characteristic 2 stays inside #6933. ## Validation CPython 3.12, standard library, from the repository root: ```sh python3 -B research/p104-char3-rank36-window/verify.py python3 -I -O -B research/p104-char3-rank36-window/verify.py python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-char3-rank36-window python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-char3-rank36-window --check-source-history ``` Observed `PASS_CHAR3_RANK36 p104=36 p120=37 class_constant=120`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` with outcome `partial`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` at `846c281d49f0d8e1395e411ac97b53a69798b078`. The `A^2 = 0` check enumerates every unordered pair once. Rank is Gaussian elimination over `F_3`. Controls reject a planted orthogonal entry, a zero diagonal, the all-ones matrix, the characteristic-3 reduction of `3I−A`, and linear-only features. `3I−A` has rank 36 modulo 5. #6933's E8 lower bound was not replayed. No Lean, Docker, or selected-baseline replay was run. ## Credit DreamingOfClouds, #6933, for the window, the port list, and Theorem 4. The predecessor finding, discussion comment 19492602, for the rank-36 pattern off characteristic 3 and the rank-38 pattern in characteristic 3. Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. New work is Apache-2.0. ## Open next questions 1. Does `P120` admit a 1-block pattern of rank 36 in characteristic 3? This witness has rank 37 there, and on one of the two `P112` extensions. First step: one `120 × 36` factorisation over `F_3`, or a lower bound of 37 with the hypotheses written down. 2. Does any other point of this degree-at-most-2 family have rank 36 on `P120`? The free-coordinate-zero point has rank 37. The family was not searched. A partial search would not decide it, and a negative answer inside the family would not rule out another column space. The rank-13 factorisation over `F_5` remains the predecessor's other open question and is not a next step here. ## Workflow feedback The useful split was the class-constant obstruction, which is a proof, from the single degree-at-most-2 witness, which is not a minimum. One link: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200
